title: standards.json — the external competency spine and its crosswalk

rights.description: Whether this framework's identifiers and unit titles may be reproduced here. Deliberately mirrors the instrument_rights.json posture: a grant is quoted verbatim and captured with a date, never summarised, because a permission sentence on a web page can change without notice.

status.description: granted means an affirmative third-party educational grant was located and quoted. not-established means no grant was found — which is NOT the same as no grant existing, and must not be treated as a refusal.

grantText.description: The permission language VERBATIM. Required when status is granted.

archivedCopy.description: Repo-relative path to a dated capture of the permission page. Required when status is granted — this, not the live URL, is the record of what the source said.

titlesReproducible.description: May this framework's unit TITLES be shown verbatim on a shipped page? False forces reference mode: cite the identifier, paraphrase the title.

rotationRequirement.description: For the 4-week adult inpatient resident rotation only. 'elsewhere' means the program addresses it on a different rotation and this one is correctly silent — that is a coverage ANSWER, not a gap.

internalCodes.description: Mapped internal content codes. An EMPTY array is meaningful and is not a defect on its own: the internal vocabulary is a disorder taxonomy and this is a competency taxonomy, so some units are unmappable by construction. bin/check_standards_coverage.py reports them.

review.description: Faculty review of this unit's rotation requirement and mapping. Nothing here is publishable while pending.
